# Jeremy Dai

> AI Engineer based in Shanghai. Building RAG & Agent systems in production.

## About
Jeremy Dai is an AI Engineer at KAWO, building Kevin — an AI marketing agent serving 500+ global enterprise brands. Previously at txyz.ai (AI research startup, 500K+ users) and Accenture Netherlands where he led a team of 8 on AI digitization of 30 million Holocaust documents from the Arolsen Archives (UNESCO Memory of the World). That project won the V360 Global Innovation Award and produced 2 NLP patents.

Background spans traffic engineering (US/Canada), MSc Statistics (Leiden University, graduated ahead of schedule), and MSc Civil Engineering (Texas A&M). Lived in 4 countries.

## Core Skills
- LLM/AI: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, Prompt Engineering, MCP
- NLP: LayoutLM, CRF, OCR, Text Classification
- Stack: Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Docker, PostgreSQL

## Key Projects
- **Arolsen Archives**: AI digitization of 30M Nazi persecution records. 40x productivity increase. 2 NLP patents. V360 Innovation Award.
- **Kevin (KAWO)**: AI marketing agent for 500+ enterprise brands. Multi-agent on LangGraph + Qwen.
- **hi-time & hi-money**: Personal productivity tools turning life data into AI-processable text.
